Hasil PertandinganMatch Result

U-15 Menang 3–1 atas Candi Youth FCU-15 Beat Candi Youth FC 3–1

Dua gol Surya M. dan satu gol Rayhan G. mengamankan tiga poin di laga kandang Liga Akademi Sidoarjo U-15.A brace from Surya M. and a goal from Rayhan G. secured three points at home in the Sidoarjo Academy League U-15.

Senin, 10 Agustus 2026Monday, 10 August 2026

GarudaKids U-15 mengamankan kemenangan 3–1 di kandang sendiri pada lanjutan Liga Akademi Sidoarjo.

Tim tampil dominan sejak awal babak pertama dengan penguasaan bola yang rapi dan transisi cepat ke sepertiga akhir.

Coach Arya menilai peningkatan terbesar ada pada disiplin posisi saat kehilangan bola.

GarudaKids U-15 secured a 3–1 home win in the Sidoarjo Academy League.

The team dominated from the opening half with tidy possession and quick transitions into the final third.

Coach Arya noted the biggest improvement was positional discipline when out of possession.
